Name: Builder Assistant 建筑助手
Description: Android-first Builder Assistant. v0.9.0 adds ORIENTED vanilla blocks — stairs, half-blocks (slabs), fences and doors — across all material variants, migrating the blueprint exchange format from schemaVersion=1 to schemaVersion=2. Each cell may now carry an optional family tag (f: cube/stairs/slab/fence/door) plus authored data bits (d: rotation / upside-down / isTop / four fence connection arms / door rotation+open+hinge). A new pure, game-independent Core/Blueprints/BlockOrientation codec owns all orientation math (Normalize/Rotate/MirrorX/family tag mapping) and was derived from the decompiled x25.01.17 Game assembly (StairsBlock/SlabBlock/FenceBlock/DoorBlock data accessors, Block.GetPlacementValue facing, and the SubsystemFence/Stairs/Door behavior auto-connect/auto-top logic), NOT guessed. Only orientation the block itself owns is stored: stair corner-joints and every block color are engine-derived and deliberately stripped so a blueprint never bakes state the engine would recompute differently — matching the standing no-garbage rule. VanillaBlockPalette now maps concrete type names to a family and packs data via Terrain.MakeBlockValue; the old SupportedPlainCubes set is retained as a Cube subset. Doors are a genuine two-cell block: a blueprint/copy stores ONLY the bottom half and writing it makes SubsystemDoorBlockBehavior auto-create the matching top, and the copier detects the upper half so it is skipped (never double-placed → the old 'target no longer air' abort cannot occur), and the generator already emits just the bottom, facing into the room on solid foundation. Quarter-turn rotation and X-mirror now transform authored data through the same codec (verified group law: four turns = identity; mirror = involution; door hinge flips on mirror), so copied/AI structures turn correctly. The medieval cottage generator was reworked to actually use the new families (wooden stairs eaves exercising all four facings, a wooden door, stone-slab windowsills, fence ridge finials) while overwriting existing cells so the block count and safety envelope stay within the 1024/32/64 limits. Safety model is unchanged: default no-overwrite-non-air + explicit confirm, main-thread-only batched writes, chunk-readiness pre-check, bounded stall, and undo that only restores cells the player has not since edited. schemaVersion=1 files (no f/d) still decode and load as plain cubes, so older blueprints keep working. Offline Core+Generators+JSON+orientation tests now pass 267/267 and net472 compiles 0 errors/0 warnings against the real x25.01.17 assemblies; the palette mapping and ON-DEVICE RENDERING of every stairs/slab/fence/door variant on the 7723 Android target remain 待验证 (pending real-device verification). Earlier release history follows. v0.8.2 expands the copy/build material palette with more plain stone/brick cubes: Basalt, Granite, Marble, Sandstone, Clay, Limestone and Malachite are added to VanillaBlockPalette.SupportedPlainCubes (5 -> 12), so both live-region COPY and imported/hand-authored blueprints can now reproduce these blocks. This is a whitelist-only change: the blueprint schema stays schemaVersion=1, the terrain write path still packs data=0/light=0, and entity-bearing / stateful (fluid/ice/snow) / gravity (sand/gravel) / spread (grass/soil) / unbreakable (bedrock) / oriented (log) blocks remain deliberately refused. A whitelisted name that is not a registered in-game block simply fails to resolve and the build/import aborts cleanly (it can never place a wrong block). Known caveat: PaintedCube-family members are pasted in the engine default color because per-cell color is not part of the terrain value; preserving color is reserved for a later schemaVersion=2 with a color payload. On-device RENDERING of each newly added block on the 7723 Android target is 待验证 (pending real-device verification). v0.8.1 makes import frictionless: no more creating folders or hand-writing files — copy a blueprint JSON onto the phone clipboard, tap the Blueprint Tool (903) and it paste-imports directly. The pasted text runs through a new pure BlueprintImportService that reuses the SAME BlueprintJson.Decode parser + vanilla-material pre-flight as file import (no second parser), enforces a raw-size cap, and on success auto-saves a uniquely-named, NON-overwriting copy to the library while preserving the readable (CJK) display name inside the JSON — fixing the old bug where pure Chinese names all collapsed to 'blueprint' and clobbered each other. Illegal input (empty, over-size, malformed JSON, unknown material, duplicate coords, over cap) is rejected with a precise reason and NEVER touches the current clipboard or writes terrain. The loaded blueprint is then placed with the existing Builder Tool (901) two-tap confirm through the SAME BuildPlanner/BuildTask/undo pipeline, so every safety rule (main-thread-only writes, single-player WorkType.Local gate, default no-overwrite + explicit confirm, chunk-readiness pre-check, batched apply, safe rollback/undo) is unchanged. The clipboard read is wrapped in a guarded adapter (GameInterop) because Game.ClipboardManager is a public Game.* type that is NOT part of the documented SCNET Mod API: it compiles against the verified Windows x25.01.17 assembly, but its Android/7723 runtime is 待验证, and when unavailable it falls back gracefully to the v0.8.0 toast + file-library browse. A separate reserved interface for an Android SAF file picker is stubbed but marked 不支持 (未接入) pending native-call verification. Offline Core+Generators+JSON+browser+import+naming+material-palette tests now pass 203/203, XDB merge-safety guards 7/7, net472 compiles 0 errors/0 warnings against the real x25.01.17 assemblies. v0.8.0 closed the loop 'external AI writes a blueprint JSON -> drop it on the phone -> import -> build'. New: a dedicated in-hand Blueprint Tool block (item 903). Each tap browses the Mod's blueprint library folder and loads+validates the next blueprint through the existing BlueprintJson.Decode plus the vanilla-material pre-flight; an illegal or AI-bad file (malformed JSON, over cap, unsupported block, dangling material) is rejected with a clear reason and NEVER touches the clipboard or partially imports. When the library is empty the tool prints the real library folder path (under ModsManager.UserDataPath, never a hardcoded device path) so the player can drop AI-generated .json files in with the Android system file manager. The Android file-delivery path (whether the system file manager can write UserDataPath under scoped storage) and item index 903 are 待验证 (pending real-device verification). v0.7.0 adds the generic JSON blueprint bridge that will carry future AI-generated buildings. New: a dependency-free strict JSON parser/writer (Core/Json), a blueprint exchange format (BlueprintJson, schemaVersion=1) with serialize/parse/validate round-trip, two-corner live-region COPY (BlueprintCopier) that reads real blocks into a blueprint and auto-exports it, and PASTE that rebuilds a copied or imported blueprint through the SAME BuildPlanner/BuildTask/undo pipeline as the built-in cottage so every safety rule applies identically. Blueprints persist to the Mod's own library under ModsManager.UserDataPath (never a hardcoded device path), which is also the answer to Android local-file access. Fidelity is deliberately conservative: only verified plain-cube vanilla blocks are copied/pasted; stairs, slabs, oriented logs, plants, snow, fluids and entity-bearing blocks are skipped on copy and cause a clear rejection on import/paste instead of a degraded or garbage build. Quarter-turn rotation lives in pure blueprint space. Reserved-but-unsupported fields (per-cell orientation/data/props, top-level buildOps) are rejected loudly, never faked. Undo still only restores cells the player has not since edited. The game-adapter copy/paste/import paths and all Android behavior remain 待验证 (pending real-device verification). v0.6.3 adds clear-soft and a bounded stall. Clear-soft: grass/flowers/tall grass/dead bushes/snow layers and other walk-through blocks the engine flags IsCollidable==false can now be replaced by a build, but only after an explicit extra confirmation tap — never by default; fluids (water/lava), solid terrain and player structures are still refused, and undo restores the exact original plant value. Bounded stall: our own writes can briefly drop a chunk's State below Valid during the engine re-mesh; instead of aborting and rolling back the whole cottage for that transient, the executor pauses in place and retries on the next frame, giving up (with a safe rollback) only after MaxIdleAdvanceCallsDuringBuild consecutive zero-progress calls. v0.6.2 fixed the on-device false '区块未加载' abort: editability now keys on `chunk.State == Valid AND chunk.Cells != null` (never TerrainChunk.IsLoaded) and prints real chunk coordinates. v0.6.1 fixed a shipped database-merge crash from a reused Class-parameter GUID. v0.6 keeps the independent speedboat prototype (behavior unchanged).
